name_reason: Fully compliant global naming: data_fd2_ prefix + domain 'shared' (cross-system game-state scalar used by field/menu/battle/save) + descriptor 'party_total_gold' that names a gold counter. No Ghidra address residue. The 'total' qualifier is semantic (the party's aggregate gold), not an address fragment.
purpose: The party's total gold/money counter -- a single signed 32-bit scalar credited on item sales and battle/field gold gains, debited on shop purchases, displayed as an 8-digit decimal ($ label), and persisted across save/load.
logic_summary: BSS zero-init int32 scalar. Initialized to 0 by fd2_chapter_01_init (MOV dword [0x53BF3],0); restored from FD2.SAV by fd2_load_save_and_init_engine / fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher / fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot. Mutated by fd2_animate_money_increment (ADD dword), fd2_animate_money_decrement (SUB dword), and field/battle gold gains (fd2_handle_tile_event_interaction, fd2_process_battle_drop_entries). Read for the affordability check in fd2_run_buy_item_menu and for the 8-digit display in the party overview and money animators.
element_semantics: Whole 32-bit signed value = current party gold. Signedness proven by fd2_run_buy_item_menu @ 0x2F2C6: MOV EAX,[0x53BF3]; CMP EAX,[price]; JGE (signed conditional; an unsigned compare would emit JAE). Money animators format it with sprintf("%0.8d", gold). Stores/loads are full-dword MOV/ADD/SUB.
notes: Existing comment block in src/life/main.c (lines 694-715) verified accurate against ground-truth disassembly: signedness JGE @ 0x2F2C6 confirmed; chapter_01_init writer MOV dword [0x53BF3],0 @ 0x32969 confirmed; increment writer ADD dword [0x53BF3],EAX @ 0x2D43A confirmed. Memory at 0x53BF3 is zero (BSS). 21 xref sites, multiple WRITE -> non-const. No data-address plate exists (get_plate_comment is function-only); the documentation lives in the fd2_animate_money_increment / fd2_render_party_status_overview_content plates and is consistent, so no Ghidra plate change needed. Comment and name both left unchanged; nothing to rewrite.
